Review this pull request as Codex.

Focus on:
- correctness and behavioral regressions
- security or safety issues
- missing tests or insufficient verification
- configuration or workflow mistakes

Keep the review concise and actionable.
Prefer findings that are specific to the diff being reviewed.

At the very end of the review body, append the following line verbatim so the original developer (Claude) is mentioned and can apply the fixes:

@claude 上記のレビュー指摘を反映する修正コミットを作成してください。修正後の commit message には必ず `[skip-review]` を含めてください。
